criterion.relatedRequirementNotClaimedComplete: S12-009: regional technology intensity trajectories and target-delivery credibility require actual evidence, not engineering fixtures.

execution.scope: Synthetic engineering controls and type checking only; no app workflow, deployment, data approval or actual issuer qualification.

coverage: Three members × five years × all three scopes: 45 physical reconciliation rows with independently calculated activity, intensity and separate factors.
Embedded measures do not reduce supplied intensity again; multiple separate factors apply exactly once.
Embedded/separate overlap rejected for all nine scope pairings, including late member-years; duplicate separate IDs rejected within and across scopes.
Complete scope accounting, explicit factors, source, intensity, delivery and disjointness evidence required; invalid or ambiguous inputs rejected.
Scope 3 physical changes leave carbon drag, FCFE and growth unchanged for all member-years.
Scope 2 explicitly supplied electricity-price liability fractions and pass-through tested at zero, partial and full values.
Old-contract complete output identity pinned against a pre-change output hash; unsupported blanket target abatement remains rejected.
Measure ordering canonicalized; changed intensity evidence changes input identity.

scopeFields: intensityEvidence: nonempty source-reference strings for the supplied intensity path
measures: explicitly declared list, which may be empty

embeddedMeasure.effect: No extra emissions multiplier. Separate-factor fields are rejected.

separateMeasure.remainingEmissionsMultiplier: Explicit finite residual fraction in [0,1], not a target percentage inferred by the engine.
separateMeasure.effect: Scope emissions = base scope tonnes × cumulative activity ratio × supplied scope intensity multiplier × product of explicit separate remaining-emissions factors.
separateMeasure.timeBasis: Factors apply to the stated year relative to its supplied intensity path; they are not annual improvements compounded across projection years.
separateMeasure.factorBasis: Factors compose multiplicatively. Evidence must justify their residual-fraction basis and physical disjointness; standalone reductions cannot silently be reinterpreted as incremental factors.

newInputSemantics.doubleCountBoundary: Trimmed measure IDs must be unique across all three scopes within each member-year, and no separate measure may occur in any scope's embedded list. Reuse across different years or ensemble members is allowed.
newInputSemantics.crossScopeAllocation: A repeated cross-scope measure is rejected conservatively. Distinct physical allocations need distinct evidence-supported identities; renaming the same physical intervention is not proof of disjointness.
newInputSemantics.noInventedFacts: No intensity, measure, delivery probability, credibility score, pass-through or liability input is defaulted. An explicit empty measure list has mathematical neutral product 1, not inferred issuer evidence.
newInputSemantics.legacyAbsence: Omitting the entire optional block retains the old contract: supplied intensity is final and there is no extra abatement.

newOutputSemantics.declaredAccounting: Validated and canonically ordered all-scope declarations are retained alongside reconciliation in opt-in years. This binds exported intensity, measure, delivery and disjointness references to the same result/input identity.
newOutputSemantics.qualification: A declared-ID consistency result, not proof of actual physical disjointness or issuer delivery credibility.
newOutputSemantics.identity: Optional declarations, factors and evidence are included in inputHash; measure lists canonicalized by identity. Old inputs retain their previous result identity and limitations.
newOutputSemantics.liability: Unchanged: (post-abatement Scope 1 tonnes × explicit Scope 1 liable fraction + post-abatement Scope 2 tonnes × explicit electricity-price liability fraction) × effective carbon price × (1 − explicit pass-through). Scope 3 never contributes a direct charge.

integrationNeeds: No caller change is required for existing inputs. Do not populate new accounting blocks from arbitrary defaults or unsupported targets.

identityNamespaceAssessment.default: Repeated raw project/measure ID across scopes remains rejected. No automatic scope-prefixing or identity namespace is inferred.
identityNamespaceAssessment.distinctMeasurements: Genuinely distinct physical measurements can already use explicit globally unique measureId values such as fuel-meter-A/project42 and electricity-meter-B/project42, with their own disjointnessEvidence.
identityNamespaceAssessment.separateNamespaceField: Not added: namespacing convenience would not establish physical disjointness and is unnecessary because measureId already supports explicit namespaced identifiers.
identityNamespaceAssessment.proofBoundary: Namespaced IDs remain source assertions. The engine cannot infer that different strings describe different physical projects; issuer evidence review remains necessary for qualification, not a prerequisite to implementing this requested engineering integration.
identityNamespaceAssessment.dedicatedControl: Shared raw project ID rejection and explicitly named distinct measurement acceptance are tested without changing the conditional/no-scientific-acceptance status.
